Maya Chen: Heads up — final QBR slate scrub scheduled tomorrow 10am PT. Need slide owners, 2 min exec asks, and any onboarding gaps called out. Draft: https://docs.google.com/example
Jon Park: I'll own the Dedicated capacity slide, will add throughput/burst numbers. Need updated SLA numbers from eng.
Priya Singh: I'll own onboarding gaps & success metrics. @Carlos can you confirm onboarding completion % for HorizonPay?
Carlos Ruiz: HorizonPay at 92% core onboarding, but integration tests failing for webhook. Filing bug: JIRA #HP-421
Nora Patel: I'll take renewals risk slide, pulling NRR/usage trends. Quick Q: do we want to surface quant perf regressions? :thinking_face:
Maya Chen: yes include top 2 regressions and mitigation plan. Keep it to one bullet each.
QBRBot: Reminder: presentation template updated v3 — auto-slide reorder enabled.
Jon Park: queued an ask to eng-sre for SLA numbers, tagged @eng-sre on the doc.
Priya Singh: added onboarding gap table. flagged 3 accounts w/ <70% usage for follow-up.
Carlos Ruiz: webhook fix in PR, tests pending — ETA EOD. I'll add a note to the slide: 'integration fix pending'.
Nora Patel: draft renewal risk heatmap attached. Suggest canary outreach for accounts in amber.
Maya Chen: Action items: Jon — SLA numbers by 4pm; Priya — finalize gaps + outreach list; Nora — share heatmap w/ AMs; Carlos — update slide once PR merges. Exec runthrough Friday 8:30am PT.
Jon Park: ack :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: will do. adding outreach owner column.
Carlos Ruiz: PR merged. webhook fix live on staging. setting next steps in doc.
Maya Chen: thanks all. If no blockers, I'll send the exec invite and dry-run calendar.
Priya Singh: One ask — include one customer quote for onboarding success, I have one from WillowBank.
Maya Chen: perfect, add it to the onboarding slide. Closing thread — see you at dry-run.
